372835.title: Conjecture on bichromatic triangles or quadrangles around a blue polygon
372835.review_depth: Primary body read (v1, only version): Sections 1-3, Theorem 4, Discussion, Conjecture 3, Figure 13.
372835.disposition: Reduced exactly to an inequality on pseudo-chord arrangements in a disk (NOTES.md section 1). Exhaustive canonical enumeration of all arrangements with m<=6 chords (1,2,5,19,130,1824 types): minimum corner count is always m+5, so the conjecture holds for every (k,m) with m<=6; equality cases are the non-crossing family and the pentagram. Literal statement fails trivially for k in {3,4} with no red lines and for unbounded P (zero-credit domain defects). Induction via chord deletion or wedge push fails exactly at the pentagram.
372835.precise_remaining_gap: Prove c >= sum over interior faces of (5-|f|) for every pseudo-chord arrangement in a disk; Lean cost very high (pseudoline face model).
